summary: Narrow canopy-covered lane; homes 12-16 m away and no room to pull off.
reasons: Narrow lane, dense trees at edge
Kerb inside a short, tight bend

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 12-16 m on the east side and apartments close on the west; well overlooked.
drivers.access_and_room: Lane is narrow with hedge and tree canopy at both edges; a van would block it.
drivers.traffic: Quiet side lane with light local traffic.
drivers.convention: Only one or two cars stand near the junction; no sign of overnight parking.

flags: Slope about 6.8%, over the 3% steep mark
sun_shade: Heavy tree shade over the lane from both sides.

best_section.where: Brasted Street east kerb, up from the give-way junction under trees
